data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's smoothness discriminator is defeated by a checklist whose thresholds are themselves graded or item-difficulty-dependent. It assumes mere compliance is binary pass/fail per item, but a well-engineered checklist can encode confidence tiers or adjust its decision threshold by item features. In that case compliant panel errors near the boundary follow a smooth gradient as item difficulty varies, making mere compliance indistinguishable from genuine reliability by the proposed test.
